messages:
sara li: DeployBot flagged spikes on embeddings route after v2.13.1 push to eu-west1 dedicated pool. Error-rate ~3.5% on /v1/embeddings. Suggesting immediate auto-rollback.
deploy-bot: DeployBot: Canary failure detected for release v2.13.1. Reason: runtime-exception on embed path. Recommend auto-rollback to v2.13.0.
kevin kwan: Wait on auto-rollback. The change was a lib upgrade that changes tokenization behavior; rolling back the service could cause mismatched embedding schema with already-processed objects.
ana garcia: +1 to Kevin. We have long-running async jobs that assumed the new tokenization. Rolling back might create more inconsistency.
mirek nowak: What about pinning traffic for new customers only and draining current jobs? Can we split traffic by header or route tag?
kevin kwan: Yes. We can target new session header X-Model-Version. Plan: 1) Pin existing customers to v2.13.0 via routing rule. 2) Keep v2.13.1 for experiments and run a hotfix that fixes tokenizer fallback. 3) Only rollback if hotfix fails within 15m.
sara li: How do we pin quickly? Need exact commands and comms. Ops will handle.
kevin kwan: Pin command (ops):
```bash
routectl set-weight --route dedicated-eu-west1 --version v2.13.0 --weight 100 --match-header "X-Client-Release: existing"
```
This routes existing clients to 2.13.0 while new/untagged use default (2.13.1) for now.
deploy-bot: Note: auto-rollback will proceed in 5m if no operator override. Use DeployBot override to cancel.
nana garcia: I'll add the override and run the pin. Drafting customer brief now.
nana garcia: Customer note draft: "We detected increased error rates for embeddings in eu-west1 after a library update. We're routing existing customers to the prior stable version to protect ongoing jobs and applying a targeted fix to restore compatibility. We'll provide updates in 30 minutes." Keep short.
mirek nowak: Hotfix prep: revert tokenizer to legacy fallback when unknown token encountered, patch weight update, redeploy as v2.13.1-hotfix. CI artifacts ready.
kevin kwan: Ops executed pin: routectl returned 200. Verified traffic counts: existing clients now on v2.13.0. New sessions limited to test slice ~5%.
sara li: Running smoke tests on embed path against hotfix build.
sara li: Smoke: hotfix passes local sims; test slice 5% shows 0.6% errors (down from 3.5%).
deploy-bot: DeployBot: Canary metrics improved for v2.13.1-hotfix. Auto-rollback cancelled by operator override.
kevin kwan: Decision: no global rollback. We pinned existing customers, deployed hotfix, will monitor for 30m. If errors rebound or data-compat issues appear then perform manual rollback and DB migration reverse.
oncall-bot: Incident recorded: INC-2042, sev: P2, scope: Dedicated eu-west1 embeddings; mitigation: routing pin + hotfix; follow-up: postmortem and release-note addenda assigned.
sara li: I'll open the postmortem draft and add a section on tokenization compatibility checks to our preflight checklist. Closing thread when postmortem link added.
